name: @chamber/proto
description: Generated TypeScript types + descriptors for the repo's protobuf contracts (chamber.v1 options, domain datagrams). The single home for generated code — domain packages depend on this so neither the SDK nor any app vendors another domain's generated code.
comment:exports: Only the PRODUCTION contract namespaces are publicly exported. The test-only testkit.v1 fixture is generated here (one home for codegen) but deliberately NOT exported, so production code can't import it; the SDK's own tests reach it via a relative path into ./gen/testkit.
